The '''EG-79 shotgun''' was a type of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] [[Shotgun/Legends|shotgun]] produced during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
